args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 is a high severity unbounded recursion issue when parsing
deeply nested arrays. It affects fastjson <2.9.4, and the current pin
(2.8.0) is in the affected range. 2.9.4 contains the fix.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the `fastjson` dependency pin from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4`.

## Security
This addresses **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The affected range is `<2.9.4`, which includes the pinned 2.8.0. The fix is available in 2.9.4 (also 3.1.0 on the 3.x line, but 2.9.4 is the minimal change).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `c8b8ab7878`.

cc @alex for review
